title: [diffusion] Progressive resolution growing for Image and Video models via GPU DCT upsampling with up to 2X+ speedup
body:
# Spectral Progressive Diffusion (FLUX.1, FLUX.2, Qwen-Image, Z-Image, Wan)

## Motivation

Transformer attention is O(n²) in sequence length. For image/video diffusion models, early denoising steps operate almost entirely in the low-frequency regime — high-frequency spatial detail has not yet been activated by the diffusion process. Spending full-resolution compute on these steps is pure waste.

**Spectral progressive resolution growing** runs early steps at a coarser spatial resolution, then spectrally upsamples the latent to full resolution for the steps where fine detail matters. The upsample is **Bayes-optimal**: we measure the empirical power spectrum of VAE latents for each model and compute the exact noise level at which Nyquist-band frequencies first carry more signal than noise.

title: [AMD][gfx95] DSV4 wo_b (dp-attention): route to tuned bpreshuffle GEMM instead of triton
body:
## What

Under dp-attention the DSV4 `wo_b` back-projection GEMM has shape (N=7168, K=16384).

On gfx95 (ROCm ≥ 7.2) this shape currently routes to the triton a8w8 block-scale path via the `use_aiter_triton_gemm_w8a8_tuned_gfx950` whitelist. That path is *not* tuned for this shape, whereas `gemm_a8w8_blockscale_bpreshuffle` has a full per-M tuned config for it.

This PR drops the single `(7168, 16384)` whitelist entry. That one change is self-consistent: the weight is `(16,16)`-shuffled at load and runtime dispatch hits `gemm_a8w8_blockscale_bpreshuffle`, which then picks the best backend per-M from its tuned table. No extra HBM, no op-selection special-casing.

```diff
-        (7168, 16384),
```

The pure-TP shape `(7168, 2048)` (K=2048) is untouched and keeps using triton.
